flows:
Navigate to https://www.canada.ca/en.html then Use the locked 320 CSS pixel viewport and scroll vertically only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
At 320px width, assert the main Travel theme link or the site search field fits within the visible width.
Activate Travel without horizontal scrolling and verify the Travel theme page opens, or focus search and verify it accepts text.
